label: input v during the copy phase
explanation: Fires only when the copy-phase input (the model fed-back output) is the letter v; essentially 100% of activation mass is on such steps, and it never fires in the original or delimiter phase (an original-phase v gives nothing). It fires on only about 64% of copy-phase v steps, and none of the conditions tried (recall position, t, v count, out token) cleanly separate the silent cases. Firing rate and magnitude are lowest early in the sequence (t<=6, recall_idx 1, many outputs still to go) and highest when v is re-input late in long sequences; top activations are v as the last copy input. Repeated v (in_count>1) gives a somewhat lower rate.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: v, n, -, i, h, w; least: s, r, 2, <DEL>) and the next token to output (most: t, b, z, p, 0, m; least: u, i, v, n); timing cues that raise it most: L=5 & t=9, t=17, recall_idx=8.
